narrative.title: The Courier Relay Reachability
narrative.scenario: A courier network spans relay posts in a line; each post advertises how many hops forward it can dispatch. A parcel starts at the first post and must reach the final one. The dispatcher tracks the farthest post reachable so far — if the scan ever lands beyond that frontier, the chain is broken and delivery fails.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums where nums[i] is the maximum hop length from post i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if the last post is reachable from the first, false otherwise.

testCases.explanation: Hop to post 1, then its 3-hop range covers the final post.
The zero post strands the parcel — every route dead-ends before index 4.

hintLevels: Level 1: Ask only one question per index — is it inside the frontier built so far?
Level 2: Maintain the farthest reachable index; a gap between frontier and current index is fatal.
Level 3: The scan never needs explicit jumps — the frontier absorbs every local reach in one pass.
